title: Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair (TEER) for Mitral Valve Regurgitation

criteria.text: Symptomatic moderate-to-severe/severe functional MR despite stable max GDMT (+CRT if appropriate), or significant symptomatic degenerative MR, per FDA indication
criteria.span: For the treatment of symptomatic moderate-to-severe or severe functional mitral regurgitation (MR) when the patient remains symptomatic despite stable doses of maximally tolerated guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) plus cardiac resynchronization therapy, if appropriate, or for the treatment of significant symptomatic degenerative MR when furnished according to a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved indication
The procedure is furnished with a mitral valve TEER system that has received FDA premarket approval (PMA)

criteria.text: Functional MR: heart failure cardiologist documents persistent symptoms despite max GDMT/CRT
criteria.span: for patients with functional MR, the heart team heart failure cardiologist must document that the patient has persistent symptoms despite maximally tolerated GDMT and cardiac resynchronization therapy, if appropriate

criteria.text: Functional MR: interventional cardiologist and HF cardiologist independently evaluate face to face (HF cardiologist may use record review if established advanced-HF cardiologist relationship)
criteria.span: For patients with functional MR: the heart team interventional cardiologist and heart team heart failure cardiologist independently evaluate the patient using information in the medical record and a face-to-face examination

criteria.text: Degenerative MR: interventional cardiologist and cardiac surgeon independently evaluate face to face
criteria.span: For patients with degenerative MR: the heart team interventional cardiologist and heart team cardiac surgeon must independently evaluate the patient using information in the medical record and a face-to-face examination

criteria.text: Interventional echocardiographer may not also provide anesthesia
criteria.span: The interventional echocardiographer may not also furnish anesthesiology during the same procedure

criteria.text: Interventional cardiologist trans-septal experience (>= 20 career incl. 10 as primary)
criteria.span: With participation in ≥ 20 career trans-septal interventions including 10 as primary or co-primary operator

criteria.text: Heart team and hospital participate in a national audited registry
criteria.span: The heart team and hospital are participating in a prospective, national, audited registry

criteria.text: Not covered when comorbidities preclude expected benefit
criteria.span: For patients in whom existing co-morbidities would preclude the expected benefit from a mitral valve TEER procedure

criteria.text: Not covered with untreated severe aortic stenosis
criteria.span: In patients with untreated severe aortic stenosis

criteria.text: Suitability for surgical repair, TEER, or palliation evaluated, documented, and shared
criteria.span: Each patient's suitability for surgical mitral valve repair, TEER, or palliative therapy must be evaluated, documented, and made available to other heart team members
